subject: science
passage: Most cheeses are solid all the way through. Emmental, ______ is famous for its large round holes, which cheesemakers call "eyes." The eyes form as bacteria in the ripening cheese release carbon dioxide gas, which collects in small pockets and slowly expands them. Researchers in Switzerland have also found that tiny particles of hay in the milk give the gas places to gather, which may explain why cheese made from very clean modern milk often has fewer eyes.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "However" interrupts the sentence "Emmental is famous for its large round holes" to signal a contrast with the sentence before. An interrupting word is set off by a pair of commas; the first comma is already there after "Emmental," so a second comma must follow "however."
explanation.A: Incorrect. A semicolon can't separate the subject "Emmental" from its verb "is."
explanation.B: Incorrect. The comma after "Emmental" opens a pair, so a matching comma must close it after "however."
explanation.C: Correct. The comma after "however" completes the pair of commas that sets off the interrupting word.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete independent clause; it can't separate a subject from its verb.
